sentences.en: Say thank you to the house before you leave it.

sentences.vi: Thở ra đi.

sentences.en: The song ends young.
sentences.ipa: /ðə ˈsɔŋ ˈɛndz ˈjʌŋ/
sentences.vi: Bài hát tắt khi còn trẻ.
